about: Manual corrections to the automatic HUD property <-> LIHTC record matching (tools/match_lihtc.py). Read by tools/lihtc_overrides.py: tools/match_lihtc.py and tools/build_lihtc_all.py honor it on a full rebuild, and tools/apply_lihtc_overrides.py patches the built assets/hud_data.js and assets/lihtc_all.js in place. Record ids are the LIHTC record's state id or HUD id (LI 'id' / 'hudId').
